summary: Two flatmates forget their reusable shopping bag, buy only the groceries they need, arrange fragile eggs safely, pay by card and share the items on the way home.
cliffhanger: At home they will put the reusable bag by the door before their next shopping trip.
visual_hook: At the supermarket entrance, Marta checks her handbag and realizes the reusable shopping bag is missing.
everyday_problem: The reusable bag was left at home and the roommates want to avoid buying another bag.
practical_resolution: They buy only bread, a small milk carton and eggs, carry them carefully between two people, and plan to hang the bag by the door.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Ich habe die Einkaufstasche zu Hause vergessen.
scenes.fa: ساک خرید را در خانه فراموش کرده‌ام.
scenes.scene: At a modern Berlin supermarket entrance, Marta opens her empty handbag while Lukas holds a small shopping basket.
scenes.motion: Marta checks her handbag, looks up at Lukas and speaks with a mildly concerned expression.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Wir können eine Tüte an der Kasse kaufen.
scenes.fa: می‌توانیم کنار صندوق یک کیسه بخریم.
scenes.scene: Two roommates by the supermarket basket stand, Lukas gestures toward the distant checkout.
scenes.motion: Lukas takes a basket and points calmly toward the checkout while replying; Marta listens.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Ich möchte nicht schon wieder eine neue kaufen.
scenes.fa: نمی‌خواهم باز هم یک کیسهٔ تازه بخرم.
scenes.scene: Marta and Lukas walk into the grocery aisle, keeping their small basket between them.
scenes.motion: Marta shakes her head gently and speaks; Lukas slows his step and listens.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Dann nehmen wir nur das Nötigste mit.
scenes.fa: پس فقط چیزهای ضروری را می‌گیریم.
scenes.scene: Medium two shot at the start of the grocery aisle; Lukas looks at the empty basket.
scenes.motion: Lukas holds up the small basket and makes one practical open-hand gesture while speaking.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Brot, Milch und Eier stehen auf meiner Liste.
scenes.fa: نان، شیر و تخم‌مرغ در فهرستم هستند.
scenes.scene: Marta checks a small handwritten grocery list without legible text; Lukas stands beside her.
scenes.motion: Marta counts the three items on her fingers while speaking, then puts the list in her pocket.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Die Milch ist heute etwas teurer.
scenes.scene: Lukas compares two plain unbranded milk cartons on a supermarket shelf; Marta watches.
scenes.motion: Lukas picks up a large milk carton, glances at the shelf label and speaks naturally.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Dann nehmen wir die kleinere Packung.
scenes.scene: Marta reaches for a smaller plain milk carton beside the larger one held by Lukas.
scenes.motion: Marta takes the smaller carton and places it carefully in their basket while replying.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.scene: Both roommates beside the refrigerated shelf, small carton visible in their basket.
scenes.motion: Lukas nods, puts the larger carton back on the shelf and speaks.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Bitte leg das Brot nicht auf die Eier.
scenes.fa: لطفاً نان را روی تخم‌مرغ‌ها نگذار.
scenes.scene: Marta holds an egg carton while Lukas is about to put a wrapped loaf on top of it in the basket.
scenes.motion: Marta gently stops the loaf with her free hand and speaks; Lukas pauses without dropping anything.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Stimmt. Die Eier kommen nach oben.
scenes.fa: درست است. تخم‌مرغ‌ها را بالا می‌گذاریم.
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of both roommates arranging a small basket with bread, milk and eggs.
scenes.motion: Lukas places the loaf below and sets the egg carton gently on top while replying.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Ich bezahle heute mit meiner Karte.
scenes.scene: At a supermarket checkout, Marta holds a plain bank card near the payment terminal; Lukas waits with the groceries.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks then taps her card on the terminal; Lukas picks up the wrapped bread.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Gut. Ich trage die Milch und das Brot.
scenes.fa: خوب است. من شیر و نان را می‌برم.
scenes.scene: Just beyond the checkout, Lukas holds the bread and small milk carton while Marta carries the eggs.
scenes.motion: Lukas secures the milk and loaf in his arms and speaks; Marta carefully takes the egg carton.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Nächstes Mal hängt die Tasche gleich an der Tür.
scenes.fa: دفعهٔ بعد ساک را کنار در آویزان می‌کنیم.
scenes.scene: The roommates walk out of the supermarket with the three items safely in their hands, natural street in background.
scenes.motion: Marta speaks with a small relieved smile; Lukas nods as they walk together at a normal pace.
